program.title: 12-Week Program
program.subtitle: From beginner to sustainable habits — step by step, week by week

phases.name: Foundation
items: Master 6 fundamental movements: Squat, Hinge, Push, Pull, Core, Breath
Start sleeping before 11 PM and eating enough protein

phases.name: Build Base
items: Add 1–2 sets per exercise, try harder variations
Add 2 light cardio sessions/week (20–30 min walking)
Start a training journal: sets, reps, how you felt
Track sleep quality and energy levels daily
Goal: 4–5 sessions/week, miss no more than 1

phases.name: Personalize
phases.goal: Customize to your goals and preferences
items: Choose your direction: fat loss / muscle gain / endurance
Increase intensity according to your chosen goal
Progress test at week 8 and week 12
Build a meal plan suited to your goal
Goal: be able to plan next week's training yourself

weekly_days.desc: Squat, Hinge, Push, Pull, Core — 20–30 min
Full rest or light movement as preferred

tips.title: Consistency over intensity
tips.desc: Training 3–5 times/week consistently beats heavy sessions followed by long breaks. 20 min daily beats 2 hours monthly.

tips.title: Progressive overload
tips.desc: Increase no more than 10% volume or sets per week. This rule prevents injury and burnout over the long term.

tips.title: Sleep is the recovery drug
tips.desc: 7–9h every night. Muscles grow while you sleep, not while you train. Sleep deprivation reduces performance by 20–30%.

tips.title: Hit your protein daily
tips.desc: 1.6–2g protein/kg bodyweight. Prioritize whole foods: eggs, lean meat, tofu, Greek yogurt.

tips.title: Keep a training journal
tips.desc: Just 5 min per session: log sets, reps, how you felt. Journals let you see progress when your body cannot.

tips.title: Be patient with results
tips.desc: Real results come after 4–8 weeks of consistent training. The early weeks are your body learning, not being lazy.

program.progress_note: Test in the morning after waking, before eating. Record and compare across checkpoints.

progress_rows.test: Bend and touch floor with fingers

program.cta_text: Every great journey begins with one small step. Today is day one of week one.

contact.mission: Mission: Make health knowledge simple, free, and accessible to everyone.
